title: What is the air you breathe made of?
subtitle: Share out the pie: how much of the air you breathe is nitrogen, oxygen and argon? Then see where carbon dioxide's tiny sliver fits.
notes: Review round 2026-10-04: slices reordered (Oxygen, Argon, Nitrogen) so no label sits straight above the pie: the template's radius grows ~8 %; 'argos = lazy' under the Argon label; 'CO₂: 0.04 %' outside the pie with a dashed hairline to the argon sliver; 'in → out' cue on the nitrogen line.
